newsitem.title: USA: Merl to acquire Universal Life Insurance.
newsitem.headline: Merl to acquire Universal Life Insurance.

text.p: Merl Industries said Wednesday it had received shareholder response from Universal Life Insurance Co pursuant to a tender offer, allowing it to buy 53 percent control of Universal which it intends to merge into a Merl unit.
Merl said the controlling interest will allow it to receive unissued shares in Universal, giving it 81 percent ownership in Universal.

Last December, Merl exercised its option to buy 105,263 authorized but not issued shares of Universal. When Merl merged Universal into its unit, Johnson's Universal Life Insurance Co, the subsidiary would have abouut $75 million in assets and revenues of about $22 million.
Universal is a privately-held company based in Memphis, Tennessee.
